summary: One focused behavior within the leaf limits: the tier-3 simulation foundation. The 4-6 predator/territorial CreatureDefs in production content (src/content/secret/hiddenCreatures.ts) carrying each organism's size class, its section 10 signature rule category, and the fields WI-03c1b's controllers will read; the section 11.1 data-level minimums encoded in the definitions; and the section 10 damage model per size class in the simulation (small killable quickly, medium killable but costly, large deterable not worth killing, no HP bar exposed in this tier or below). The definitions and the damage model are two facets of one observable outcome, not two independently shippable features: the damage table is keyed on the size classes the definitions carry, and neither lands usefully without the other - the 4-6 creatures are data rows, not 4-6 behaviors, since each creature's actual non-pursuit signature behavior is explicitly WI-03c1b's, along with the per-predator headless signature scenarios (WI-03c1b), production spawns and rendering (WI-03c2), large/colossal staging (WI-03d), and the FINAL PROOF roster-wide AC-roster-behavior check. Changed subsystems are exactly two concrete owners, under the three-leaf cap and a strict subset of the story's three. AC-roster-behavior is retained verbatim and shared with WI-03c1b, which is named the FINAL PROOF OWNER, and the union of the two children covers both parent criteria (AC-roster-tests sits with WI-03c1b). depends_on: [] is correct - the leaf inherits WI-03b through the WI-03c story and ST-01/ST-02 through ST-03, with the do-not-start-before-WI-02a/b/c gate stated in the handoff, and it depends on no ancestor or descendant. Verification is focused headless evidence for this item alone: every tier-3 CreatureDef resolves in the production world data (ids, size class, rule-category fields), the section 10 damage-model table holds per size class (harpoon cost, deter success, no-kill for large, no HP bar) without any specific predator controller, and the large-predator deterable-not-killable interaction is exercised headlessly. Constraints are carried in: section 11.2 anti-cliche hard gate, section 46 shark test per species, and the sections 0/12/33/68 spoiler rules (internal ids only, no creature names in normal UI). The fresh-session handoff names the parent plan, the numbered request sections, WI-01b for the selected organism ids, and design_private/ as source of truth, so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project. Matches exactly the leaf shape the parent WI-03c1 split receipt prescribed.
